parts.instruction: For each question, choose the correct answer.

questions.text: Please note: this afternoon’s football class will be tomorrow instead, as Mr Hall is away today.
questions.a: There is no football class today.
questions.b: Mr Hall can’t come to the football class tomorrow.
questions.c: You can choose to go to the football class today or tomorrow.

questions.text: Hi Jane, Have you finished with that book I lent you? It’s just that my brother needs it for a school project.
questions.a: Louise is offering to lend Jane a book.
questions.b: Louise wants her book back from Jane.
questions.c: Louise’s brother has borrowed a book from Jane.

questions.text: Picnic area: No ball games here – please use the other side of the park.
questions.a: You can buy food somewhere else in the park.
questions.b: Please don’t eat while you are playing sport here.
questions.c: This is a place for eating and you can’t play football here.

questions.text: Museum open from 12. Children must be with an adult.
questions.a: Adults can take children to the museum in the morning.
questions.b: Adults with children over 12 will enjoy the museum.
questions.c: Children can visit the museum if they are with an adult.

questions.text: Mrs Monmouth: This week, please don’t use the car to get to school. Coming on foot is healthy.
questions.a: to ask pupils to walk to school
questions.b: to tell pupils to get to school on time
questions.c: to explain about a health problem at school

questions.text: Pedro’s Pizza Bar: Buy two pizzas, get a third one for free! Mon-Fri only.
questions.a: Pedro’s Pizza Bar isn’t open at weekends
questions.b: The third time you visit, you get a free pizza.
questions.c: Three pizzas cost the same as two.

parts.passage:
A. Eureka!
Hands-on experience, visitors can pick up any object. Ticket valid for a year.
B. Museum of Museums
Things lent by other museums. Many vehicles (vans, motorbikes, public transport).
C. Cinema Museum
Bought from cinemas closing down (posters, seating, uniforms). Organised tours only.

questions.text: Which museum has an exhibition of clothes?
Which museum is full of things which visitors can touch?
Which museum is a good place to learn about how people travelled?
Which museum can you visit again for free after you pay once?
Which museum do you need to contact before you visit?
Which museum shows things that were borrowed from other places?
Which museum has some furniture which wasn’t needed any more?

parts.passage: Will’s Blog: My dad said, 'Why don't we have a street party?'... It was interesting to see photos from 1977... My mum was worried guests wouldn't talk to each other... but it was great!

questions.text: Why was Will surprised?
questions.a: His father wanted to have a street party.
questions.b: There hasn't been a street party for a long time.
questions.c: Many people remembered the last street party.

questions.text: What did the photos from 1977 show?
questions.a: The street still looks the same now.
questions.b: There are more children living in the street now.
questions.c: The same people still live on the street now.

questions.text: Why was Will’s mother worried?
questions.a: She thought that the party was too expensive.
questions.b: She thought that people might not come.
questions.c: She thought that the guests might not talk to each other.

questions.text: Will and his friends enjoyed
What is the best title for the article?
questions.c: How to have a street party
